title: Bijectivity of the canonical open-object cohomology map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $q\in\mathbb N$, and $U\subseteq X$ open [def-weil-open-immersion]. The explicitly constructed map $m_U:\operatorname{Ext}^q(A_U,F)\to H^q(U_{et},j_U^*F)$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map] is bijective. No compatibility between different opens is asserted.

source.place: Lemma cohomology-of-open, proof by restriction of an injective resolution; free-representable/Yoneda and constant-sheaf adjunctions. Explicit identity-generator construction and unit compatibility supplied by F2.

proof.text: Prove the degree-zero identity-generator Hom comparison using lem-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-hom-bijective. Ext.mk₀_bijective, mapExactFunctor_mk₀, and mk₀_comp_mk₀ identify the degree-zero Ext map with that Hom map.

Extension by zero along U is exact and left adjoint to Etale.upperStar. Apply the Mathlib right-adjoint preservation theorem to obtain that the actual upperStar functor preserves injectives. The small étale sheaf category has enough injectives. Hence both Ext functors vanish in positive degree on an injective second argument, as follows from the injective-resolution computation of Ext (implemented by Ext.eq_zero_of_injective).

The private extComparison_bijective helper proves the higher-degree comparison by induction. Embed F into an injective I and form the actual cokernel Q. Exactness of upperStar maps the resulting short exact sequence to a short exact sequence. Use Mathlib Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃′ for the right-exact segment Ext^n(A,I) -> Ext^n(A,Q) -> Ext^(n+1)(A,F) -> 0, and its analogous segment after pullback. Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, mapExactFunctor_mk₀, and mapExactFunctor_extClass, followed by Ext.comp_assoc, give the two commuting squares for the specified comparison. Induction gives bijections on the I and Q terms. AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_right_exact gives the next-degree bijection. This constructs the comparison through finite injective presentations rather than explicit resolution complexes; it works also for q=0, F=0, and the empty open.

proof_origin.place: Lemma cohomology-of-open: exact extension by zero and preservation of injectives. E3 implements the derived comparison by degree-zero adjunctions and dimension shifting using the proved Mathlib Ext exact-sequence API, in place of explicit resolution complexes.
